back_to_hub.copy: Head back Home to continue exploring what Qortal has to offer.
back_to_hub.title: Back to Hub

choose_channel.copy: Groups organize conversations into channels, so each topic has its own place. Here's where you'll choose a channel.
choose_channel.title: Choose a Channel

direct_messages.copy: You can also message another Qortal user privately. Open Direct Messages to start a conversation.
direct_messages.info: Press Direct Messages again to return to your Groups.
direct_messages.title: Direct Messages

enter_qortal_land.copy: Launch Qortal Land from Hub's Home Dashboard. You must be a member of at least one Q-Chat group before you can enter.
enter_qortal_land.copy_group: Every group has its own <emphasis>QortalLand</emphasis> space. You can enter it from this control after joining the group, or directly from the Home Dashboard.
enter_qortal_land.copy_group_details: QortalLand is an early, growing social world where group members can meet, interact, and play minigames such as Chess and Checkers. Its spaces, activities, and possibilities will keep expanding as new features arrive.
enter_qortal_land.title: Enter Qortal Land

explore_qapps.copy: Browse all available Q-Apps and discover more of what's being built on Qortal.
explore_qapps.title: Explore Q-Apps

featured_qapps.copy: This section features a few community-made <emphasis>Q-Apps</emphasis> that help make Qortal what it is today.
featured_qapps.details: <emphasis>Q-Apps</emphasis> are decentralized apps anyone can build with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, using Qortal's blockchain, APIs, and peer-to-peer QDN to publish, share, grow, or monetize ideas. QDN encrypts and chunks data during storage and transit, with no central host able to censor or remove an app network-wide. Each user controls what their own node accesses or blocks.
featured_qapps.title: Featured Q-Apps

find_group.copy: Browse groups you can join. The official <emphasis>Qortal Project</emphasis> group is always pinned first in the Top ranking.
find_group.title: Search for Groups

find_groups_location.copy: Use this search button whenever you want to find and join new groups.
find_groups_location.title: Find Groups

join_group.copy: Join a group to access its conversations and channels. "Qortal Project" is a great place to start.
join_group.copy_member:
You're already a member of <emphasis>Qortal Project</emphasis>, Qortal's official community group for news, support, conversation, and contact with contributors.

Let's take a quick look around!
join_group.copy_preview: <emphasis>Qortal Project</emphasis> is Qortal's official community group for news, support, conversation, and contact with contributors. Joining requires QORT and blockchain confirmation, so we'll continue with a guided preview without joining.
join_group.title: Join a Group

message_expiry.copy: Direct messages expire automatically after 1 month by default. You can change the expiry period here.
message_expiry.info: Choose the expiry period before sending new messages. Changes do not apply to messages that were sent earlier.
message_expiry.title: Message Expiry

open_qchat.copy: Q-Chat is where conversations happen across Qortal. Open it to get started.
open_qchat.title: Open Q-Chat

preview.notice: You haven't joined this group. Joining requires QORT and confirmation on the Qortal blockchain.
preview.qortino_message: Welcome! Groups bring each community's channels, conversations, and QortalLand space together. This preview lets you look around without joining or spending QORT.

ready.copy: That's the basics. Explore Qortal at your own pace, and you can restart this tour anytime if you need it.
ready.title: You're ready

skip_reminder.copy: You can restart this tutorial at any time from Settings > Help.
skip_reminder.title: Tutorial skipped for now

welcome.copy:
The Home Dashboard is your starting point for Qortal Hub.

Let's take a quick tour of the basics!
welcome.title: Welcome to Qortal Hub

subscription.empty_body: Subscribe to creators and communities from Q-Apps that support subscriptions, such as SubWire.

support.no_agents_online_hint: No agents are currently online. Please try again later.
support.say_hello: Say hello to start the conversation.
support.select_ticket: Select a ticket from the queue

whats_new.closing_note: This is the beginning of the new Q-Chat. More social experiences, community tools, and refinements are already on the way.

comparison.body: Legacy Q-Chat established decentralized social communication inside Qortal. The Reticulum edition builds on that achievement with a network and interface designed for faster, more interactive daily conversation.

discovery.legacy: Member count and established group information
discovery.reticulum: Search, practical filters, previews, and Group Score

live.reticulum: Text, mentions, direct chat, calls, and proximity voice

organization.legacy: A group generally centered on one conversation
organization.reticulum: Channels and categories inside the same group

comparison.title: From legacy Q-Chat to Reticulum Q-Chat

transport.legacy: Chat messages recorded through Qortal transactions

calls.description: Start one-to-one and group calls without leaving Q-Chat. Group calls support up to seven people and begin in a compact view that can be expanded whenever you need it.
calls.title: Calls that stay out of the way

channels.description: Groups can organize discussion into channels and categories. There is no longer a need to create a separate group for every subject.
channels.title: One community, many conversations

discovery.description: The new Group Score brings holdings, activity, history, and community size into one clear 0–100 score, helping active public groups stand out in Find Groups and invitations.
discovery.title: Discover communities with context

expiry.description: Choose how long messages should remain, from 24 hours to one week, or keep them with no expiry. Replies, mentions, attachments, editing, and richer message tools make everyday chat easier.
expiry.title: Messages on your terms

network.description: Q-Chat now uses Reticulum for its real-time conversations while keeping Qortal identities and group membership at the center. Messages feel immediate, dependable, and at home inside the Hub.
network.title: A faster chat network

qortalland.description: Enter a new shared social space where you can meet other members, use moods and proximity voice, and challenge people to Chess, Checkers, or Qonnect Four, all from inside your community.
qortalland.title: Introducing QortalLand

whats_new.intro_body: This release combines Qortal's community identity with the speed of Reticulum. It is a substantial evolution of Q-Chat: quicker to use, easier to organize, and built for richer ways to spend time together.
whats_new.intro_title: A new foundation for Qortal conversations
whats_new.title: What's new in Q-Chat
